title: Scannable-Unofficial
description: This is an unofficial version of the Scannable mod (originally authored by Sangar) for version 1.21.1
body:
# Scannable-Unofficial
![Module Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba1e13485ed2e18f28e08fcbcec9dc3327a0cdfe.png)
This is [Scannable](https://modrinth.com/mod/scannable) of NeoForge 1.21.1 Unofficial version.

## Features

**Scanner Modules:**
- Range - Increases scan radius by 50%
- Block - Detect specific blocks
- Entity - Find specific entity types
- Fluid - Locate water, lava and fluids
- Friendly Entity - Detect animals and villagers
- Hostile Entity - Find hostile mobs
- Item - Scan containers for specific items

**Additional Features:**
- Energy-based scanning system
- Visual progress indicator and sound effects
- Configurable energy costs and scan ranges
- JEI integration
- Multi-language support (English, Chinese)

## Usage

1. Craft or find scanner in creative tab
2. Shift+Right-click to install modules
3. Right-click blocks/entities to configure modules
4. Hold Right-click to scan

## Configuration

All settings can be adjusted in `config/scannable_unofficial-common.toml`:
- Base scan radius (default: 64 blocks)
- Individual module energy costs
- Ignored blocks list

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.228+
- Java 21
